name: TOM Post Effects
description: Client-side VFX library: ping-pong FBO post-processing (chromatic aberration, color grading, distortion, dent, gradient map, posterize, blur, pixelate, hue isolation, vignette, screen flash, motion blur), camera shake, block tint/outline overlays, keyframe animation, world/camera bindings, datapack-defined effects, sound triggers and a public Java API.
